task: CPU Cooler Installation with Thermal Paste

steps.text: Switch off the power supply with the rocker switch at the back of the case and unplug the power cable.

source.quote: Switch off the power supply with the rocker switch at the back of the case and unplug the power cable.

steps.text: Touch the bare metal of the case to discharge static electricity.

source.quote: Touch the bare metal of the case to discharge static electricity.

steps.text: Wipe the processor surface with isopropyl alcohol and a lint-free cloth.

source.quote: Wipe the processor surface with isopropyl alcohol and a lint-free cloth.

steps.text: Peel the protective plastic film off the base of the cooler.

source.quote: Peel the protective plastic film off the base of the cooler.

steps.text: Squeeze one pea-sized drop of thermal paste onto the centre of the processor. Do not spread it; the cooler's pressure will do that.

source.quote: Squeeze one pea-sized drop of thermal paste onto the centre of the processor. Do not spread it; the cooler's pressure will do that.

steps.text: Lower the cooler straight down onto the processor, aligning the four screws with the four mounting holes. Do not slide it.

source.quote: Lower the cooler straight down onto the processor, aligning the four screws with the four mounting holes. Do not slide it.

steps.text: Tighten the four screws in a diagonal pattern: top-left, bottom-right, top-right, bottom-left. Give each screw two turns at a time and repeat until all four are snug. Never fully tighten one screw before the others.

source.quote: Tighten the four screws in a diagonal pattern: top-left, bottom-right, top-right, bottom-left. Give each screw two turns at a time and repeat until all four are snug. Never fully tighten one screw before the others.

steps.text: Plug the cooler fan cable into the CPU_FAN header.

source.quote: Plug the cooler fan cable into the CPU_FAN header.

steps.text: Plug the power cable in and switch the power supply on.

source.quote: Plug the power cable in and switch the power supply on.

steps.text: Confirm that the fan spins and the processor temperature is below 60 C at idle.

source.quote: Confirm that the fan spins and the processor temperature is below 60 C at idle.
